_doc: Showcase trailer shots (TrailerShotDef; make trailer-shot SHOT=<id>). Ids are the clip ids of the cut (tools/trailer/edit.json); dur is what the cut keeps, tail the handle recorded after it. Positions are [x, y, z] offsets from anchor [x, z], y above the ground at the anchor (camera.terrain_follow: above the ground under each key).

defs._doc: Opens on black: a slow drone push down the Tamsin in the first light, mist on the water.

Pell's Crossing: the crane rises off Church Lane until the crossroads and Route 9's storefronts lie open below. It keeps to the lane's east half: the street lamp at framework (36.2, 106) hangs its head over the west half at the crane's height.
The Hum seen from above, under the full moon: the horde floods across the meadow at the hidden player.
defs._day: The second Hum (day 14) falls on a full moon (world_clock.json moon), filmed past midnight with the moon high: on day 7's waning crescent, or with the moon low at 22:00, the meadow is black (SDFGI lights the night from the sky).
